mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS propertyId, p.title AS title, p.trade_type AS tradeType, p.deposit AS deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, p.evaluation_score AS evaluationScore, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM property_image pi WHERE pi.property_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS imageUrl, p.property_type AS propertyType, p.area_m2 AS areaM2, p.floor_info AS floorInfo, p.address AS address FROM favorite_property f JOIN property p ON p.id = f.property_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite_property (user_id, property_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{propertyId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite_property WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND property_id = #{propertyId}
